name: EMerge FEM Simulation
description: Run the EMerge FEM solver directly from the KiCad PCB editor. Exports Gerbers, builds a 3-D FEM model from the board stackup, runs a frequency sweep, and produces Touchstone (.s2p) and a pass/fail report against configurable S-parameter thresholds.
description_full:
EMerge FEM Simulation Plugin for KiCad

The plugin reads all material and geometry data directly from the open .kicad_pcb file — the board stackup is the single source of truth (no hardcoded dielectrics). Port definitions (ref:pad notation, impedance, direction) are stored in emerge_config.toml next to the plugin.

Workflow triggered from the toolbar button:
  1. Gerber export via kicad-cli
  2. FEM model build (FileBasedPCB, open_pml_region, series/parallel impedance ports)
  3. Frequency sweep (configurable start/stop/steps, cells-per-lambda)
  4. Touchstone export and pass/fail against IL / RL thresholds

Results written to  <pcb_parent>/sim/emerge/results/
